capital_accounting.interpretation: The replacement-capital accounting relationship remains extremely stable across the entire phase grid.

claim_updates: The expected recruitment-rate buffering of the direct day240 underground shock is falsified over the tested band.
The tested grid does not support a pressure-induced overmobilization-collapse phase by day360.

At the highest tested recruitment rate, temporary underground pressure is followed by substantially less cumulative recruitment, a larger persistent rooted-stock deficit, and preserved capital relative to the no-disruption branch.
This high-rate pattern is labeled regenerative throttling or hysteresis only as a development hypothesis until its dynamic access mechanism is decomposed and then confirmed on fresh seeds.
The source-derived recruitment-capital tradeoff is the most robust cross-rate mechanism in this phase map.
